render.prompt: Static camera, no push, no zoom, no pan, one single unbroken six-second take from this one camera only. Start exactly from the first frame and end exactly on the given final frame, one continuous take without any cut; the camera never changes position, height or angle. The closed leather book, the Portfolio Handbook with its gold title, brass corners, red ribbon marker and the leather strap buckled across it, lies centred on the flat magenta plate with wide magenta on every side, exactly as in the first frame. The brass buckle unclasps and the two ends of the strap part and lie flat on the book; the strap stays on the book the whole time, never hangs below it, never flies away, and is hidden beneath the open pages by the end. The front cover lifts from its right edge and swings open on its spine toward the left, low and flat, never rising higher than the closed book is tall, the book turning to lie flat and face-on to the camera as it opens, staying centred and small enough that the whole book, its cover and its strap remain inside the frame with wide magenta visible around them at every moment, never touching an edge; the pages fan once and settle, until the book lies fully open as a two-page spread of blank hand-torn parchment with the stitched spine down the middle, exactly as in the final frame, and rests there for the last second. Nothing else moves; the magenta stays flat with no shadow anywhere.
